name: Git Diff
description: Side-by-side diff with partial (hunk and line) staging, commit box, pull/push and recent history for any Git repository on your shares. Opening a diff from the Code Editor's Source Control panel focuses this app. Repository access stays in EthOS, behind its path scope.
author: SyncHot
changelog: 1.0.0: first release. The Git Diff desktop app moves out of the core install; the git endpoints stay in EthOS's editor API, so the Code Editor keeps handing diffs to it.
